Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test: src/forge/release-notes/v1.2.50.md lists every client-visible change merged since v1.2.49 and the release notes tests pass; nothing else changes
Case: normal use - a client relies on the upgrade notes to understand which explorer or merge behavior applies.
The two previously identified inaccurate sentences are corrected, but the proof gap remains. `tests/test_release_notes.py:22-45,138-155` checks fixture notes and older releases, while `tests/test_release_version.py:81-99` checks structure rather than the v1.2.50 claims. The previous inaccurate sentences passed these checks, and the unchanged tests would also pass if the same mistakes returned or new client-visible bullets were omitted.
